verses.sloka: ततः शरेण अभिहतो रामेण रण कर्कशः ।पपात सहसा वाली निकृत्तैव पादपः ॥४-१७-१॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śareṇa abhihato rāmeṇa raṇa karkaśaḥ ।papāta sahasā vālī nikṛttaiva pādapaḥ ॥4-17-1॥

translations.english: A tyrant in war, Vali struck by4.54.24 Rama's arrow, collapsed instantaneously like a tree felled down.
translations.hindi: इति सप्तदशः सगः ॥ . यह कहते कहते महाबलबान वालि का सुख सूख गया और सेर के घाव से वह व्यथित हो गया। फिर सूर्ये के समान प्रकाश- शत श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को सामने देख, इन्द्रपुत्र बालि चुप हे श्या ।। ५२ किष्किन्धाकार्ड का उम्नीसवाँ सर्ग पूरा हुआ । ३ न AES -ण£%-- अष्टादशः सग; ८ धत > इत्युक्तः प्रश्रित वाक्यं धर्माथसहितं हितम्‌ । परुपं वालिना रामो निहतेन विचेतसा

verses.sloka: स भूमौ न्यस्त सर्वांगः तप्त कांचन भूषणः ।अपतत् देव राजस्य मुक्त रश्मिर् इव ध्वजः ॥४-१७-२॥
verses.transliteration: sa bhūmau nyasta sarvāṁgaḥ tapta kāṁcana bhūṣaṇaḥ ।apatat deva rājasya mukta raśmir iva dhvajaḥ ॥4-17-2॥

translations.english: Adorned with shining gold ornaments,Vali fell down with all his limbs touching the ground like Indra's flag when its ropes are loosened.
translations.hindi: आभाहीन सूर्य, अथवा जलरहित मेघ, अथवा बुझी हुई आग. के समान, धर्मा्थ-गुण-वुक्त वचना से, उत्तम वानरनाथ वालि द्वारा आक्षेप क्रिए जाने पर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी वाति से बोले

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ हरि ऋषाणाम् गणेश्वरे ।नष्ट चन्द्रम् इव व्योम न व्यराजत मेदिनी ॥४-१७-३॥
verses.transliteration: asmin nipatite bhūmau hari ṛṣāṇām gaṇeśvare ।naṣṭa candram iva vyoma na vyarājata medinī ॥4-17-3॥

translations.english: When the lord of the monkey troops fell down, it was as though the earth lost its brightness like the sky loses its brightness devoid of the Moon.

verses.sloka: भूमौ निपतितस्य अपि तस्य देहम् महात्मनः ।न श्रीर् जहाति न प्राणा न तेजो न पराक्रमः ॥४-१७-४॥
verses.transliteration: bhūmau nipatitasya api tasya deham mahātmanaḥ ।na śrīr jahāti na prāṇā na tejo na parākramaḥ ॥4-17-4॥

translations.english: Even though the highsouled Vali's body had fallen on the ground, its splendour, glow, life and valour had not left it.
translations.hindi: घर्म, अर्थ, काम और लोकिकाचार को जाने विना ही, तुझे बालक की तरह, मेरी निन्दा क्यों करते हो ?

verses.sloka: शक्र दत्ता वरा माला कान्चनी रत्न भूषिता ।दधार हरि मुख्यस्य प्राणान् तेजः श्रियम् च सा ॥४-१७-५॥
verses.transliteration: śakra dattā varā mālā kāncanī ratna bhūṣitā ।dadhāra hari mukhyasya prāṇān tejaḥ śriyam ca sā ॥4-17-5॥

translations.english: As the most beautiful golden necklace, studded with diamonds, given by Indra was there on him, the life, brightness and splendour of Vali's body remained.

verses.sloka: स तया मालया वीरो हैमया हरियूथपः ।संध्यानुगत पर्यन्तः पयोधर इव अभवत् ॥४-१७-६॥
verses.transliteration: sa tayā mālayā vīro haimayā hariyūthapaḥ ।saṁdhyānugata paryantaḥ payodhara iva abhavat ॥4-17-6॥

translations.english: Vali, the chief hero of the monkeys, with his golden necklace appeared like the raincloud hallowed by the glowing twilight.
translations.hindi: क्या तुम नहीं जानते कि,) पर्वतो ओर बनो सहित यह समस्त भूमण्डल इच्वाकुवंश बालों का है। इस अखिल भूमण्डल में जितने पशु पक्षा मनुष्य रहते हैं, उन सव को दरड देने अथवा उन पर अजुभ्रह करने का इच्चाकुबं शवालों को अधिकार हे

verses.sloka: तस्य माला च देहः च मर्मघाती च यः शरः ।त्रिधा इव रचिता लक्ष्मीः पतितस्य अपि शोभते ॥४-१७-७॥
verses.transliteration: tasya mālā ca dehaḥ ca marmaghātī ca yaḥ śaraḥ ।tridhā iva racitā lakṣmīḥ patitasya api śobhate ॥4-17-7॥

translations.english: Even though he had fallen down, the effulgence of his necklace on his body, and the arrow pierced into his vital parts remained.
translations.hindi: भरतजी, जो सत्यचादी, सीधे, धर्म, काम और अर्थ के तत्व के ज्ञाता तथा अपराधियों को दण्ड देने ओर साधुओं पर अनुग्रह करने में तत्पर हैं, इस समय इस भूसणडल का रासन कर रहे हैं.

verses.sloka: तत् अस्त्रम् तस्य वीरस्य स्वर्ग मार्ग प्रभावनम् ।राम बाणासन क्षिप्तम् आवहत् परमाम् गतिम् ॥४-१७-८॥
verses.transliteration: tat astram tasya vīrasya svarga mārga prabhāvanam ।rāma bāṇāsana kṣiptam āvahat paramām gatim ॥4-17-8॥

translations.english: Rama's arrow released paved the way to heaven which was that hero's supreme destination.
translations.hindi: भरतजी नीतिवान और शिक्षित राजा हैं । वे सत्याचरण में 'निरत हैं और पराक्रमी होने के साथ साथ यथोचित देश काल के ज्ञानते वाले हैं.

verses.sloka: तम् तथा पतितम् संख्ये गत अर्चिषम् इव अनलम् ।ययातिम् इव पुण्यान्ते देव लोकात् परिच्युतम् ॥४-१७-९॥
verses.transliteration: tam tathā patitam saṁkhye gata arciṣam iva analam ।yayātim iva puṇyānte deva lokāt paricyutam ॥4-17-9॥

translations.english: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.

verses.sloka: आदित्यम् इव कालेन युगान्ते भुवि पातितम् ।महेन्द्रम् इव दुर्धर्षम् उपेन्द्रम् इव दुस्सहम् ॥४-१७-१०॥
verses.transliteration: ādityam iva kālena yugānte bhuvi pātitam ।mahendram iva durdharṣam upendram iva dussaham ॥4-17-10॥

translations.english: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.
translations.hindi: ह उन राजसिंह और घर्मबत्सस राजा भरत के राज्यकाल सें किस पुरुष में सामर्थ्य है, जो धर्मविरुद्ध कोई कर्म कर सके?

verses.sloka: महेन्द्र पुत्रम् पतितम् वालिनम् हेम मालिनम् ।व्यूढ उरस्कम् महाबाहुम् दीप्तास्यम् हरि लोचनम् ॥४-१७-११॥
verses.transliteration: mahendra putram patitam vālinam hema mālinam ।vyūḍha uraskam mahābāhum dīptāsyam hari locanam ॥4-17-11॥

translations.english: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मण अनुचरो रामो ददर्श उपससर्प च ।तम् तथा पतितम् वीरम् गत अर्चिष्मतम् इव अनलम् ॥४-१७-१२॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇa anucaro rāmo dadarśa upasasarpa ca ।tam tathā patitam vīram gata arciṣmatam iva analam ॥4-17-12॥

translations.english: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.
translations.hindi: तुम धर्म को सताने वाले, कुकर्स में रत, केवल काम के दास बन कर, राजधमे की उपेक्षा कर रहे दो

verses.sloka: बहुमान्य च तम् वीरम् वीक्षमाणम् शनैरिव ।उपयातौ महावीर्यौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥४-१७-१३॥
verses.transliteration: bahumānya ca tam vīram vīkṣamāṇam śanairiva ।upayātau mahāvīryau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥4-17-13॥

translations.english: On seeing powerful Rama and Lakshmana approaching,Vali spoke with pride and rigteousness to Rama, 'You are a prince, born of a noble family, son of a renowned king. You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'
translations.hindi: न धर्ममार्ग पर चलने वाले जनों के मतानुसार आ भाई, पिता ओर विद्यादाता शुरु ये तीनों ही जन्मदाता (पता के बराबर हुँ

verses.sloka: तम् दृष्ट्वा राघवम् वाली लक्ष्मणम् च महाबलम् ।अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् प्रश्रितम् धर्म संहितम् ॥४-१७-१४॥
verses.transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā rāghavam vālī lakṣmaṇam ca mahābalam ।abravīt paruṣam vākyam praśritam dharma saṁhitam ॥4-17-14॥

translations.english: On seeing powerful Rama and Lakshmana approaching,Vali spoke with pride and rigteousness to Rama, 'You are a prince, born of a noble family, son of a renowned king. You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'

verses.sloka: स भूमौ अल्पतेजोसुः निहतो नष्ट चेतनः ।अर्थ सहितया वाचा गर्वितम् रण गर्वितम् ॥४-१७-१५॥
verses.transliteration: sa bhūmau alpatejosuḥ nihato naṣṭa cetanaḥ ।artha sahitayā vācā garvitam raṇa garvitam ॥4-17-15॥

translations.english: On seeing powerful Rama and Lakshmana approaching,Vali spoke with pride and rigteousness to Rama, 'You are a prince, born of a noble family, son of a renowned king. You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'
translations.hindi: हे वानर! सज्जनों का धर्म ऐसा सूकम हे कि, सहज में उसे कोइ जान नहीं सकता । परन्तु वह धर्म प्रत्येक प्राणी के हृदय में बन्तेमान है । इसीसे अन्तरास्मा द्वारा ही शुभाशुभ का ज्ञान हुआ करता है

verses.sloka: त्वम् नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रथितः प्रिय दर्शनः ।पराङ्मुख वधम् कृत्वा को अत्र प्राप्तः त्वया गुणः ।यदहम् युद्ध सम्रब्धः त्वत् कृते निधनम् गतः ॥४-१७-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tvam narādhipateḥ putraḥ prathitaḥ priya darśanaḥ ।parāṅmukha vadham kṛtvā ko atra prāptaḥ tvayā guṇaḥ ।yadaham yuddha samrabdhaḥ tvat kṛte nidhanam gataḥ ॥4-17-16॥

translations.english: All beings proclaim your fame throughout the world, saying: Rama is compassionate, devoted to his people's welfare, kindly, enthusiastic, mindful of the right occasion, and steadfast in his vows.
translations.hindi: तुम बन्दर की जाति के आर चञ्चल स्वभाव के हा! तुम अपने जैसे अशिक्षित बुद्धिवाले बंदरों के साथ परामरो कर धर्मे की सूच्मगति को कैसे जान सकते हो ! क्योंकि जो मनुष्य ज्न्सान्ध होता हे वह यदि किसी दूसरे जन्मान्ध के साथ वरामशै कर, सागे जानना चाहे तो क्या उसे मागे मिल सकता है!

verses.sloka: कुलीनः सत्त्व संपन्नः तेजस्वी चरितव्रतः ।रामः करुणवेदी च प्रजानाम् च हितेरतः ॥४-१७-१७॥
verses.transliteration: kulīnaḥ sattva saṁpannaḥ tejasvī caritavrataḥ ।rāmaḥ karuṇavedī ca prajānām ca hiterataḥ ॥4-17-17॥

translations.english: All beings proclaim your fame throughout the world, saying: Rama is compassionate, devoted to his people's welfare, kindly, enthusiastic, mindful of the right occasion, and steadfast in his vows.
translations.hindi: ऽब सैं अपने इस कथन को स्पष्ट किए देता हूँ । तुम केवल द्वेष में सर सुके दोषी नहीं उहरा सकते

verses.sloka: सानुक्रोशो महोत्साहः समयज्ञो दृढव्रतः ।इति एतत् सर्व भूतानि कथयन्ति यशो भुवि ॥४-१७-१८॥
verses.transliteration: sānukrośo mahotsāhaḥ samayajño dṛḍhavrataḥ ।iti etat sarva bhūtāni kathayanti yaśo bhuvi ॥4-17-18॥

translations.english: 'O king selfcontrol (of organs of action and sense organs), righteousness, steadfastness, truthfulness, valiance and capacity to punish the offenders are virtues of a king.
translations.hindi: जिस लिए मैंने तुमको मारा है, पहिले उसका कारण जान लो । तुमने सनातन धमे को छोड़, अपने छोटे भाई की भार्या को आपनी भार्या बना लिआ हे

verses.sloka: दमः शमः क्षमा धर्मो धृति सत्यम् पराक्रमः ।पर्थिवानाम् गुणा राजन् दण्डः च अपकारिषु ॥४-१७-१९॥
verses.transliteration: damaḥ śamaḥ kṣamā dharmo dhṛti satyam parākramaḥ ।parthivānām guṇā rājan daṇḍaḥ ca apakāriṣu ॥4-17-19॥

translations.english: 'Believing that you are a repository of all these virtues are in you, and respecting your noble lineage I engaged in a duel with Sugriva even though I was forewarned (by Tara).

verses.sloka: तान् गुणान् संप्रधार्य अहम् अग्र्यम् च अभिजनम् तव ।तारया प्रतिषिद्धो अपि सुग्रीवेण समागतः ॥४-१७-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tān guṇān saṁpradhārya aham agryam ca abhijanam tava ।tārayā pratiṣiddho api sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ ॥4-17-20॥

translations.english: The conviction arose in my mind that, being unseen by you, you would not strike me while I was off my guard and engaged in combat with another.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--वानर अनार्य जाति के लोग ये ह वे भी एक पति के जीवित रहते उसकी पत्नी को अपनी पत्नी बनाने के विरुद्ध थे | यद्दी बात भ्र राम ने-धरमाशस्य कद कर बतलाई है । इससे ग्राग चल कर सुग्रीव का बालि पत्नी ताण का पत्नी बताने का समर्थन होता है । तह॒व्यतीवस्य ते धर्मात्कामद्टत्तस्य वानर । श्रातभार्यावमशऽस्मिन्‌ दण्डोऽयं प्रतिपादितः

verses.sloka: न माम् अन्येन संरब्धम् प्रमत्तम् वेद्धुम् अर्हसि ।इति मे बुद्धिर् उत्पन्ना बभूव अदर्शने तव ॥४-१७-२१॥
verses.transliteration: na mām anyena saṁrabdham pramattam veddhum arhasi ।iti me buddhir utpannā babhūva adarśane tava ॥4-17-21॥

translations.english: 'I did not know that you have killed your soul (by acting against your conscience), that you are sinful in conduct and unrighteous under the show of virtues like a well, its mouth covered with grass.
translations.hindi: हे हरियूथप ! धर्म की मर्यादा को उल्लङ्घन करने बाला आए लञोक-व्यवहार की मर्यादा के विरुद्ध चलन वाले को मारने के सिवाय सुमे और कोई दण्ड नहीं देख पड़ता

verses.sloka: न त्वाम् विनिहत आत्मानम् धर्म ध्वजम् अधार्मिकम् ।जाने पाप समाचारम् तृणैः कूपम् इव आवृतम् ॥४-१७-२२॥
verses.transliteration: na tvām vinihata ātmānam dharma dhvajam adhārmikam ।jāne pāpa samācāram tṛṇaiḥ kūpam iva āvṛtam ॥4-17-22॥

translations.english: 'You are a sinful man covered with the mask of piety thus resembling a hidden fire. I failed to recognise that righteousness is a mere pretext for you.
translations.hindi: मेरा जन्म श्रेष्ठ क्षत्रिय कुज में हुआ है, अतः मैं पाप अर्थात्‌ पापी को इस तरह नहीं देख सकता। जा कोई सहोदरा भगिनी अथवा अपने छोटे भाई की स्त्री

verses.sloka: सताम् वेष धरम् पापम् प्रच्छन्नम् इव पावकम् ।न अहम् त्वाम् अभिजानामि धर्म छद्माभि संवृतम् ॥४-१७-२३॥
verses.transliteration: satām veṣa dharam pāpam pracchannam iva pāvakam ।na aham tvām abhijānāmi dharma chadmābhi saṁvṛtam ॥4-17-23॥

translations.english: 'I did no harm to your affairs or to your city. I did not insult you. Why did you choose to kill me, a monkey roaming in the forest and living on fruits and roots? I was not fighting you. Why did you come and strike a person like me?
translations.hindi: के साथ कामव्यवहार (बुरा काम) करता ह उसके लिए बध ही उचित दरड बतलाया गया है.। हम तो महाराज अरत के आज्ञापालक हें

verses.sloka: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा पापम् करोमि अहम् ।न च त्वाम् अवजाने अहं कस्मात् त्वम् हंसि अकिल्बिषम् ॥४-१७-२४॥
verses.transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā pāpam karomi aham ।na ca tvām avajāne ahaṁ kasmāt tvam haṁsi akilbiṣam ॥4-17-24॥

translations.english: 'I did no harm to your affairs or to your city. I did not insult you. Why did you choose to kill me, a monkey roaming in the forest and living on fruits and roots? I was not fighting you. Why did you come and strike a person like me?
translations.hindi: अतः हम, तुम जैसे धर्मत्याग करने बाले की उपेक्षा कैसे कर सकते हैं, क्योंकि जो बुद्धिमान धर्म ( ईमानदारी ) से प्रजा का पालन करते हैं, वे महाअधमियों का निम्नह किए बिना कैसे रह सकते हैं ?

verses.sloka: फल मूल अशनम् नित्यम् वानरम् वन गोचरम् ।माम् इह अप्रतियुध्यन्तम् अन्येन च समागतम् ॥४-१७-२५॥
verses.transliteration: phala mūla aśanam nityam vānaram vana gocaram ।mām iha apratiyudhyantam anyena ca samāgatam ॥4-17-25॥

translations.english: 'O prince, you are son to a king, handsome and famous. Even signs of righteousness are discernible in you.
translations.hindi: भरत जी ने कामाधीव और स्वेच्छाचारियों को दरड देने की व्यवस्था की हे। सो दे हरीश्वर ! दम लोग भरत के निर्देशानुसार शास्त्र की विधि का पालन करने स तत्पर रहते हैं

verses.sloka: त्वम् नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रतीतः प्रियदर्शनः ।लिन्गम् अपि अस्ति ते राजन् दृश्यते धर्म सम्हितम् ॥४-१७-२६॥
verses.transliteration: tvam narādhipateḥ putraḥ pratītaḥ priyadarśanaḥ ।lingam api asti te rājan dṛśyate dharma samhitam ॥4-17-26॥

translations.english: 'Who, born in a kshatriya family, versed in the Vedas and free from doubt will commit such a cruel act under the guise of righteousness?
translations.hindi: और तम जैसे धर्म की मर्यादा तोड्ने वालों का नियन्त्रण करने को तैयार रहते हैं । फिर सुम्रीब मेरा मित्र है। मेरे लिए जैसे लक्ष्मण हैं वैसे ही सुग्रीब भी है

verses.sloka: कः क्षत्रिय कुलेजातः श्रुतवान् नष्टसंशयः ।धर्म लिंग प्रतिच्छन्नः क्रूरम् कर्म समाचरेत् ॥४-१७-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kaḥ kṣatriya kulejātaḥ śrutavān naṣṭasaṁśayaḥ ।dharma liṁga praticchannaḥ krūram karma samācaret ॥4-17-27॥

translations.english: 'You are born in a royal family. You are wellknown. You are proficient in dharma. Yet you are unworthy of your race and robe.
translations.hindi: यह मित्रता स्त्री और राज्य के लिए हुई है, इसके लिए बानरों के सामने में सुग्रीव को बचन भी दे चुका हूं

verses.sloka: राम राघव कुले जातो धर्मवान् इति विश्रुतः ।अभव्यो भव्य रूपेण किम् अर्थम् परिधावसे ॥४-१७-२८॥
verses.transliteration: rāma rāghava kule jāto dharmavān iti viśrutaḥ ।abhavyo bhavya rūpeṇa kim artham paridhāvase ॥4-17-28॥

translations.english: 'Conciliation, generosity, forbearance, righteousness, truthfulness, steadfastness in valour and punishing offenders are the hallmarks of rulers.
translations.hindi: सो भला मुझ जैसा पुरुष अपनी प्रतिज्ञा को केसे कस है । इन्ही सब धर्मविषयक बड़े बड़े कारणा स॑ तम्हें मेने जो उचित दण्ड दिआ है, उसे तुम भी मान लो। तुम्हें जो दण्ड दिआ गया है, वह सब प्रकार से घमाचुसार है

verses.sloka: साम दानम् क्षमा धर्मः सत्यम् धृति पराक्रमौ ।पार्थिवानाम् गुणा राजन् दण्डः च अपि अपकारिषु ॥४-१७-२९॥
verses.transliteration: sāma dānam kṣamā dharmaḥ satyam dhṛti parākramau ।pārthivānām guṇā rājan daṇḍaḥ ca api apakāriṣu ॥4-17-29॥

translations.english: 'O Rama we are mere animals wandering in the forest and living on roots and fruits. This is our nature. (But) you are a lord of men.

verses.sloka: वयम् वनचरा राम मृगा मूल फल अशनाः ।एषा प्रकृतिर् अस्माकम् पुरुषः त्वम् नरेश्वरः ॥४-१७-३०॥
verses.transliteration: vayam vanacarā rāma mṛgā mūla phala aśanāḥ ।eṣā prakṛtir asmākam puruṣaḥ tvam nareśvaraḥ ॥4-17-30॥

translations.english: 'We fight for land or gold or silver. What did you fight me for, for what I have or for the fruits of the forest?
translations.hindi: मित्र के कर्तव्य की ओर दृष्टि रखते हुए, मुमे मित्र का उपकार करना उचित ही था ओर घम की ओर दृष्टि छत तमको भी यह उचित था कि, तुम प्राथनापूवेक यह दण्ड ग्रह करते

verses.sloka: भूमिर् हिरण्यम् रूपम् च निग्रहे कारणानि च ।तत्र कः ते वने लोभो मदीयेषु फलेषु वा ॥४-१७-३१॥
verses.transliteration: bhūmir hiraṇyam rūpam ca nigrahe kāraṇāni ca ।tatra kaḥ te vane lobho madīyeṣu phaleṣu vā ॥4-17-31॥

translations.english: 'Submissiveness and modesty are the attributes of good rulers and should not be mixed up with benevolence and selfrestraint. Kings ought not to act (as they like) impulsively.
translations.hindi: हे बानर ! इस बिषय में सनु जी के शुभाचरण प्रतिपादक दो शलोक सुने जाते है । इनको धमंज्ञ पुरुषों ने भी माना हे और में भी मानता हू

verses.sloka: नयः च विनयः च उभौ निग्रह अनुग्रहौ अपि ।राज वृत्तिर् असंकीर्णा न नृपाः काम वृत्तयः ॥४-१७-३२॥
verses.transliteration: nayaḥ ca vinayaḥ ca ubhau nigraha anugrahau api ।rāja vṛttir asaṁkīrṇā na nṛpāḥ kāma vṛttayaḥ ॥4-17-32॥

translations.english: 'Fulfilling your own desire is important for you. You are wrathful and unstable with royal course of conduct. Your business is with your bow and arrows.
translations.hindi: उन श्लोकों का अभिप्राय यह है कि, जो मनुष्य पाप करने पर राजा द्वारा दश्डित किए जाते हैं वे पाप से मुक्त हो, पुण्यात्मा सत्पुरुषों की तर हु, स्वर्गवासी होते हैं.

verses.sloka: त्वम् तु काम प्रधानः च कोपनः च अनवस्थितः ।राज वृत्तेषु संकीर्णः शरासन परायणः ॥४-१७-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tvam tu kāma pradhānaḥ ca kopanaḥ ca anavasthitaḥ ।rāja vṛtteṣu saṁkīrṇaḥ śarāsana parāyaṇaḥ ॥4-17-33॥

translations.english: 'O lord of men you have no faith in righteousness, no steadfastness in the acquisition of wealth. You have no control over the senses. You are overcome by delusion.
translations.hindi: जो चोर अथवा पापी स्वयं जा कर राजा से अएना पापकम कह देता है और दरड चाहता है, उसे राजा चाहे तो दण्ड दे चाहे दण्ड न देकर क्षमा कर दे | दोनों दशां में वह पापा ता पाप से छूट जाता है, किन्त राजा पापी को पाप का दण्ड न देने से स्वयं पाप का भागी हो जाता हे

verses.sloka: न ते अस्ति अपचितिः धर्मे न अर्थे बुद्धिर् अवस्थिता ।इन्द्रियैः काम वृत्तः सन् कृष्यसे मनुजेश्वर ॥४-१७-३४॥
verses.transliteration: na te asti apacitiḥ dharme na arthe buddhir avasthitā ।indriyaiḥ kāma vṛttaḥ san kṛṣyase manujeśvara ॥4-17-34॥

translations.english: 'O scion of the Kakutsthas Having killed me here with your arrow even though I have done you no harm, you have perpetrated an abominable act. How will you defend yourself in the midst of holy men after commiting such a sinful act?
translations.hindi: जैसा पाप तुमने किया है वैसा ही किसी श्रमण (बोद्ध संन्यास) ने भी किआ था और जब बह दण्डित होने के लिये महाराज मान्धाता के पास गया ; तब उन्होंने उसे दण्ड नदे कर क्षमा कर दिआ। इसके लिए महाराज मान्धाता को घोर कष्ट सहना पडा था

verses.sloka: हत्वा बाणेन काकुत्स्थ माम् इह अनपराधिनम् ।किम् वक्ष्यसि सताम् मध्ये कर्म कृत्वा जुगुप्सितम् ॥४-१७-३५॥
verses.transliteration: hatvā bāṇena kākutstha mām iha anaparādhinam ।kim vakṣyasi satām madhye karma kṛtvā jugupsitam ॥4-17-35॥

translations.english: 'One who kills a king, a brahmin or a cow, a thief or one who delights in destruction of life an atheist or one who marries before his elder they all go to hell.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--इस श्लोक में “श्रसश्‌” शब्द देख, कहना पड़ेगा कि बौद्धमत के आचार र सिद्धान्त राजा मान्धाता के समय में मी प्रचलित थे | श्रमण का अर्थ टीकाकार ने “चुपणक” किग्रा हे । क्षपणंक का अर्थं आपटे साहब ने अपने कोश में, 4 3०4० 07 Jain mendicant, लिखा हे ।] अष्टादशः सगे: १७३ अन्यैरपि कृतं पापं प्रमत्तेवेसधाधिपेः । प्रायश्चित च कुर्वन्ति तेन तच्छाम्यते रजः

verses.sloka: राजहा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नः चोरः प्राणिवधे रतः ।नास्तिकः परिवेत्ता च सर्वे निरय गामिनः ॥४-१७-३६॥
verses.transliteration: rājahā brahmahā goghnaḥ coraḥ prāṇivadhe rataḥ ।nāstikaḥ parivettā ca sarve niraya gāminaḥ ॥4-17-36॥

translations.english: A tale-bearer, a miser, a betrayer of friends, and one who defiles his guru's bed—these surely go to the world of sinners, there is no doubt.
translations.hindi: हे वानरशादूल ! अब तुम्हारा पछताना व्यथे है । क्‍योंकि यह तुम्हारा वध धर्मानुसार ही किआ गया है और में धर्मशास्त्र के वश में हूँ; स्वतन्त्र नहीं हूँ

verses.sloka: सूचकः च कदर्यः च मित्र्घ्नो गुरुतल्पगः ।लोकं पापात्मानम् एते गच्छन्ते न अत्र संशयः ॥४-१७-३७॥
verses.transliteration: sūcakaḥ ca kadaryaḥ ca mitrghno gurutalpagaḥ ।lokaṁ pāpātmānam ete gacchante na atra saṁśayaḥ ॥4-17-37॥

translations.english: 'My skin is not fit to be worn by the virtuous, my hair and bones are also prohibited from any use. My flesh is also not at all fit to be eaten by righteous people like you
translations.hindi: हे हरिपुङ्गव '| इस विषय के और भी कारण हैं, में उन्हें भी तुम्हें वतलाता हूँ । उनको सुनकर तुम अपने मन का क्रोध त्याग दो

verses.sloka: अधार्यम् चर्म मे सद्भी रोमाणि अस्थि च वर्जितम् ।अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि त्वत् विधैः धर्मचारिभिः ॥४-१७-३८॥
verses.transliteration: adhāryam carma me sadbhī romāṇi asthi ca varjitam ।abhakṣyāṇi ca māṁsāni tvat vidhaiḥ dharmacāribhiḥ ॥4-17-38॥

translations.english: 'O Rama brahmins and kshatriyas are permitted to eat only the five nailed animals the porcupine, the hedgehog, the alligator, the rabbit and the tortoise.
translations.hindi: हे हरियूथप ! मैंने तुमको जो छिप कर मारा है, सो इसके लिए न तो मुके सन्ताप है और न दुःख ही। क्योंकि अनेक शिकारी लोग जाल, फंदा और कपट व्यवहार से, छिपकर या प्रकट होकर, भागते हुए, निर्भय बैठे हुए अनेक मृग पकड़ा ही करते हैं.

verses.sloka: पंच पंच नखा भक्ष्या ब्रह्म क्षत्रेण राघव ।शल्यकः श्वाविधो गोधा शशः कूर्मः च पंचमः ॥४-१७-३९॥
verses.transliteration: paṁca paṁca nakhā bhakṣyā brahma kṣatreṇa rāghava ।śalyakaḥ śvāvidho godhā śaśaḥ kūrmaḥ ca paṁcamaḥ ॥4-17-39॥

translations.english: 'O king the learned do not even touch my skin or bone. They do not eat my flesh. While it is so, you have unnecessarily killed me, a fivenailed animal.

verses.sloka: चर्म च अस्थि च मे राजन् न स्पृशन्ति मनीषिणः ।अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि सो अहम् पंच नखो हतः ॥४-१७-४०॥
verses.transliteration: carma ca asthi ca me rājan na spṛśanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।abhakṣyāṇi ca māṁsāni so aham paṁca nakho hataḥ ॥4-17-40॥

translations.english: 'Tara knew everything. Her words were correct. They were meant for my wellbeing. However, due to my ignorance (or arrogance), I did not heed her words and fell under the sway of the lord of death

verses.sloka: तारया वाक्यम् उक्तो अहम् सत्यम् सर्वज्ञया हितम् ।तद् अतिक्रम्य मोहेन कालस्य वशम् आगतः ॥४-१७-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tārayā vākyam ukto aham satyam sarvajñayā hitam ।tad atikramya mohena kālasya vaśam āgataḥ ॥4-17-41॥

translations.english: 'O Kakutstha just as a wife endowed with good character cannot be protected by a wicked husband, you cannot be a protector of this earth.
translations.hindi: धर्म के तत्व को जानने वाले बड़े बड़े राजपि शिकार खेला ही करते हें । दे वानर ! इसीसे मैंने भी छिप कर, तुम्हें युद्ध में बाण से मारा है

verses.sloka: त्वया नाथेन काकुत्स्थ न सनाथा वसुंधरा ।प्रमदा शील संपूर्णा पति एव च विधर्मिणा ॥४-१७-४२॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā nāthena kākutstha na sanāthā vasuṁdharā ।pramadā śīla saṁpūrṇā pati eva ca vidharmiṇā ॥4-17-42॥

translations.english: 'You are treacherous, dishonest, mean, guised with false humility and a sinner to the core. How were you born to that highsouled Dasaratha?

verses.sloka: शठो नैकृतिकः क्षुद्रो मिथ्या प्रश्रित मानसः ।कथम् दशरथेन त्वम् जातः पापो महात्मना ॥४-१७-४३॥
verses.transliteration: śaṭho naikṛtikaḥ kṣudro mithyā praśrita mānasaḥ ।katham daśarathena tvam jātaḥ pāpo mahātmanā ॥4-17-43॥

translations.english: 'Breaking through the chains of good character, trespassing the moral code of conduct of the sages, discharging the sharp arrow of righteousness, the elephantine (arrogant) Rama killed me.
translations.hindi: चाहें. तम्हारे साथ युद्ध कर अथवा युद्ध न कर, मैंने तुम्हे मारा, तो इसमें दोष क्या है? क्योंकि तुस वानर तो हो ही। देखो, दुलेभ धर्म, जीवन ओर कल्याण के देने वाले राजा ही होते हैं। अतः उनको न तो मारना चाहिए न उन पर क्रोध करना चाहिए, न उन पर आक्षेप करना चाहिए और न उनसे कडुवचन कहने चाहिए ।!४२

verses.sloka: छिन्न चारित्र्य कक्ष्येण सताम् धर्म अतिवर्तिना ।त्यक्त धर्म अंकुशेन अहम् निहतो राम हस्तिना ॥४-१७-४४॥
verses.transliteration: chinna cāritrya kakṣyeṇa satām dharma ativartinā ।tyakta dharma aṁkuśena aham nihato rāma hastinā ॥4-17-44॥

translations.english: 'You have committed an inauspicious, improper act, despised by the virtuous. What will you speak when you are questioned by noble men for committing such an act?
translations.hindi: क्योंकि वे साधारण मनुष्य नहीं हैं, प्रत्युत वे मनुष्यरूपी देवता प्रथिवी पर घूमा करते हैं । त॒म तो धर्म का तिरस्कार कर केवल क्रोध के वशवर्ती हो मुझको, जो बाप दादों के धर्म पर आरूढ हूँ, दोप लगाते हो। श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के इस प्रकार कहने पर, वालि को बड़ा पश्चात्ताप हुआ

verses.sloka: अशुभम् च अपि अयुक्तम् च सताम् च एव विगर्हितम् ।वक्ष्यसे च ईदृशम् कृत्वा सद्भिः सह समागतः ॥४-१७-४५॥
verses.transliteration: aśubham ca api ayuktam ca satām ca eva vigarhitam ।vakṣyase ca īdṛśam kṛtvā sadbhiḥ saha samāgataḥ ॥4-17-45॥

translations.english: 'O king you have exhibited your valour against one who has done you no harm. Why have you not shown such valour on those who have offended you?
translations.hindi: IS प्रदूषयसि र्मा धर्मे पितृपेतामहे स्थितम्‌ । एवमुक्तस्तु रासेण वाली प्रव्यथितो भृशम्‌

verses.sloka: उदासीनेषु यो अस्मासु विक्रमो अयम् प्रकाशितः ।अपकारिषु ते राम न एवम् पश्यामि विक्रमम् ॥४-१७-४६॥
verses.transliteration: udāsīneṣu yo asmāsu vikramo ayam prakāśitaḥ ।apakāriṣu te rāma na evam paśyāmi vikramam ॥4-17-46॥

translations.english: 'O prince had you fought me face to face you would have seen Vaivasvata, the lord of death today (you would have been killed by me).
translations.hindi: वह धम की दृष्टि से सोचने लगा और भली भाँति विचार कर, उसने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को निर्दोष पाया | तब कपिराज वालि ने हाथ जोड़ कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा

verses.sloka: दृश्यमानः तु युध्येथा मया युधि नृपात्मज ।अद्य वैवस्वतम् देवम् पश्येः त्वम् निहतो मया ॥४-१७-४७॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśyamānaḥ tu yudhyethā mayā yudhi nṛpātmaja ।adya vaivasvatam devam paśyeḥ tvam nihato mayā ॥4-17-47॥

translations.english: bitten to death by a snake while fast asleep.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषोत्तम ! तुम जो कहते हो सो निस्सन्देह ठीक है । भला छुद्र जन की क्या साम्यं हे 'जो उत्कृष्ट जनों के साथ उत्तर प्रत्युत्तर कर सकें

verses.sloka: त्वया अदृश्येन तु रणे निहतो अहम् दुरासदः ।प्रसुप्तः पन्नगेन इव नरः पाप वशम् गतः ॥४-१७-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā adṛśyena tu raṇe nihato aham durāsadaḥ ।prasuptaḥ pannagena iva naraḥ pāpa vaśam gataḥ ॥4-17-48॥

translations.english: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.
translations.hindi: तदयुक्तं मया पूर्व प्रमादादुक्तमप्रियम्‌ । ति ९ तत्रापि खलु मे दोपं कतु नाहसि राघव ॥४८] पहले मेंने भूल से जो कठोर वचन कहे, हे राघव ! उनके लिए मुके तुम दोषी मत ठहराओ

verses.sloka: सुग्रीव प्रिय कामेन यद् अहम् निहतः त्वया ।माम् एव यदि पूर्वम् त्वम् एतद् अर्थम् अचोदयः ।मैथिलिम् अहम् एक आह्ना तव च आनीतवान् भवेः ॥४-१७-४९॥
verses.transliteration: sugrīva priya kāmena yad aham nihataḥ tvayā ।mām eva yadi pūrvam tvam etad artham acodayaḥ ।maithilim aham eka āhnā tava ca ānītavān bhaveḥ ॥4-17-49॥

translations.english: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.

verses.sloka: राक्षसम् च दुरात्मानाम् तव भार्य अपहारिणम् ।कण्ठे बद्ध्वा प्रदद्याम् ते अनिहतम् रावणम् रणे ॥४-१७-५०॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasam ca durātmānām tava bhārya apahāriṇam ।kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyām te anihatam rāvaṇam raṇe ॥4-17-50॥

translations.english: 'Even if she were hidden in the waters of the ocean or in the underworld, I would have brought her by your order like Sweta to Aswatari or Hayagriva. (Hayagriva, an incarnation of Visnu brought Vedas stolen by demons, Madhu and Kaitabha from Patala or the netherworld)

verses.sloka: न्यस्ताम् सागर तोये वा पाताले वा अपि मैथिलीम् ।आनयेयम् तव आदेशात् श्वेताम् अश्वतरीम् इव ॥४-१७-५१॥
verses.transliteration: nyastām sāgara toye vā pātāle vā api maithilīm ।ānayeyam tava ādeśāt śvetām aśvatarīm iva ॥4-17-51॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva inheriting the kingdom after my departure to heaven is proper. But your killing me this way in the combat by unjustifiable means is not.

verses.sloka: युक्तम् यत् प्रप्नुयात् राज्यम् सुग्रीवः स्वर् गते मयि ।अयुक्तम् यद् अधर्मेण त्वया अहम् निहतो रणे ॥४-१७-५२॥
verses.transliteration: yuktam yat prapnuyāt rājyam sugrīvaḥ svar gate mayi ।ayuktam yad adharmeṇa tvayā aham nihato raṇe ॥4-17-52॥

translations.english: 'Indeed, in the world people meet with death when the time comes. Hiding yourself (from me) you have achieved it. Is it proper for you? You may think over and give your reply.'
translations.hindi: Co ०० मी स १ दृष्टार्थतत्वश:--श्रस्मदादिज्ञानविषयीभूता थेयाथार्थ्यविज्ञाता | (शः) २ कार्यकारण सिद्वौ-_कार्य दण्डनं कारणां तद्धेतुभूतं पापं तयो {द्धौ परिज्ञाने । ( गो० ) अष्टादशः सग; क्योंकि लड़कपन से बड़े दुलार के साथ पाला पोसा हुआ मेरा बह पुत्र, मुझे न. देख कर, सूखे हुए तालाब को तरद्द सूख जायगा

verses.sloka: कामम् एवम् विधम् लोकः कालेन विनियुज्यते ।क्षमम् चेत् भवता प्राप्तम् उत्तरम् साधु चिंत्यताम् ॥४-१७-५३॥
verses.transliteration: kāmam evam vidham lokaḥ kālena viniyujyate ।kṣamam cet bhavatā prāptam uttaram sādhu ciṁtyatām ॥4-17-53॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, his mouth parched and himself stricken by the stroke of the arrow, that great-souled son of the vanara king gazed upon Rama, who resembled the sun, and remained silent.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! तारा के गर्भ से उत्पन्न मेरे एक मात्र प्यारे पुत्र अङ्गद की, जो अभी कच्ची बुद्धि का है, किन्तु हे महाबली, तुम रक्ता करो

verses.sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा परिशुष्क वक्त्रःशर अभिघातात् व्यथितो महात्मा ।समीक्ष्य रामम् रवि संनिकाशम्तूष्णीम् बभौ वानर राज सूनुः ॥४-१७-५४॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam uktvā pariśuṣka vaktraḥśara abhighātāt vyathito mahātmā ।samīkṣya rāmam ravi saṁnikāśamtūṣṇīm babhau vānara rāja sūnuḥ ॥4-17-54॥

translations.hindi: सुग्रीब और अङ्गद के विषय में आप उत्तम बुद्धि रखें, क्योंकि आप ही उनके रक्षक और शासनकर्ता हैँ ओर करने अनकर ने कामों के बारे में आप ही उनके शिक्षक हैं.
